import json

def run(_context):
    # Add the roughing/finishing tool: 1/2" 3Fl Carb TiCN Flat Endmill (index 14, 12.7mm)
    # Also add 5/16" Carbide 2Fl Flat Endmill (index 15, 7.9375mm) for finishing corners
    lib_url = "toollibraries://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)"
    
    tools = mb.list_library_tools(contains="TIW")
    
    # Find 1/2" 3Fl Carb TiCN Flat Endmill (index 14)
    rough_tool = next(t for t in tools if t['index'] == 14)
    print("Roughing tool:", json.dumps(rough_tool))
    
    # Find 5/16" Carbide 2Fl Flat Endmill (index 15, 7.9375mm) - fits the 5mm corner radius
    finish_tool = next(t for t in tools if t['index'] == 15)
    print("Finishing tool:", json.dumps(finish_tool))
    
    # Add tools to document
    r1 = mb.add_tool(rough_tool['library_url'], rough_tool['index'])
    print("Added rough tool, doc index:", r1['document_tool_index'])
    
    r2 = mb.add_tool(finish_tool['library_url'], finish_tool['index'])
    print("Added finish tool, doc index:", r2['document_tool_index'])

import json

def run(_context):
    # Add Adaptive2D roughing operation on Setup1
    # Geometry: face 13 is the top annular face (pocket opening at Z=50)
    # Using type='pocket' so fusion recognises the enclosed contour
    result = mb.add_operation(
        "Setup1",
        strategy="adaptive2d",
        tool=0,  # 1/2" 12.7mm carbide flat
        geometry={"faces": [13], "type": "pocket"},
        name="Rough_Adaptive2D"
    )
    op_name = result['operation']
    print("Operation created:", op_name)
    print("PARAMS:")
    print(json.dumps({k: v['expression'] for k, v in result['params'].items()}, indent=2))

        # Stock to leave for finishing

        "verticalStockToLeave": {"value": 0.5,   "unit": "mm"},   # axial (floor) stock
        # Depths - top of stock down 20mm to pocket floor
        "topHeight_mode":       {"value": "from stock top",  "unit": "choice"},
        "topHeight_offset":     {"value": 0.0,   "unit": "mm"},
        "bottomHeight_mode":    {"value": "from stock top",  "unit": "choice"},

        "tool_feedCutting":     {"value": 1800,  "unit": "mm"},   # mm/min
        "tool_feedPlunge":      {"value": 300,   "unit": "mm"},   # mm/min
